title: Researchers say hacker used DeepSeek-driven AI agent to steal residents’ data from a service provider for Flemish municipalities
date_note: Researchers’ findings were published 25 November 2026; the campaign ran from 6 to 15 November per the pages.
org: Service provider for Flemish municipalities (not named)
geo_basis: Flemish municipalities; the provider and municipalities are not named, Brussels used for Belgium
actor: Ghost Hunters (APT90), as named by Secutec and SOCRadar
summary: Secutec and SOCRadar say a hacker linked to Ghost Hunters (APT90) used DeepSeek to run an AI agent against a service provider's central server, exposing data of approximately 1.2 million residents and employees across 82 municipalities, according to Anadolu citing VRT. Secutec says the hacker sent more than 5,800 instructions to the model between 6 and 15 November. The CCB says it cannot confirm the figures; the East Flanders prosecutor has opened an investigation.
plain: Researchers say a hacker used an AI agent steered by DeepSeek to steal ID and personal data tied to approximately 1.2 million residents and employees across 82 Flemish municipalities.
exec: Researchers report municipal residents' identity data stolen through a service provider, with an AI agent doing much of the work; authorities have not confirmed the figures.
action: Secutec and SOCRadar say multi-factor authentication and IP restrictions held off the attacks; SOCRadar published detection rules and indicators for IT teams to search their logs.
impact: Stolen data includes names, addresses, birth dates, national register and ID card numbers and IBANs, according to ITdaily and Computable.

evidence.quote: more than 5,800 commands to the AI model
approximately 1.2 million residents and employees across 82 municipalities
Tussen 6 en 15 november heeft de hacker meer dan 5.800 opdrachten doorgegeven aan het model.

validation.note: VRT, Anadolu (relaying VRT), ITdaily and Computable report the Secutec/SOCRadar findings; VRT also quotes the CCB (cannot confirm the figures) and the prosecutor's investigation. The researchers' own reports and a statement from the provider were not read.
